name: Nishi-Shinjuku
tagline: Shinjuku in 2 minutes and Shibuya in 12 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 22 minutes to Otemachi, 2 minutes to Shinjuku, 12 minutes to Shibuya and 33 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 37.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 37.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 25.8 m to 39.4 m, a difference of 13.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: オリンピック 北新宿店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 10 clinics and 23 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東京医科大学病院, about 2 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is myhospital, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000 and 2LDK ¥320,000 to ¥330,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Nishi-Shinjuku, but Tochomae is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishi-Shinjuku. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Nishi-Shinjuku. One-room rents run about ¥17,000 higher.

noiseSources: 青梅街道 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
The nearest big road, 東通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
